critique: The black field, white particles, and overall fine-grain distribution are substantially closer to the intended Brownian Motion fluid thumbnail. However, the t1-to-t4 change still reads chiefly as a pronounced particle accumulation: t4 is much denser than t1 rather than appearing as the same already-established field undergoing agitation. A visible minority of particles remain noticeably chunky, which disrupts the predominantly fine dust texture.

suggestions.why: Create a much denser field immediately at startup while nearly eliminating the continuing emission that causes the strong t1-to-t4 population ramp.
Reduce the remaining oversized bright flecks so the particle field reads more consistently as fine Brownian dust.
